02 / Frequently asked questions

Clear answers. No guesswork.

The important details about building your website, paying, editing, and getting support.

What is Vowella?

Vowella helps you get a polished website without having to design and build every part yourself. Choose a ready-made template, share your details, and we’ll prepare your site to be published.

How does the process work?

Choose a template, send us your name and the content you want included, arrange payment through our contact process, and we’ll prepare and publish your website. You’ll receive a link you can share.

How much does it cost?

It costs ₹70 to get started. If you need a custom website or extra features, we’ll explain any additional cost and confirm it with you before proceeding.

How do I make a payment?

Contact us using the official contact details on the site. We’ll guide you through the available Razorpay or Google Pay payment option. Always verify the payment request before paying, and never share your UPI PIN or one-time password.

Is the payment secure?

Payments are made through the Razorpay or Google Pay flow we share with you. Use only verified payment links or details provided through our official contact process.

Can I edit my website after it is published?

Yes. The website can be edited for 45 days after publication. After the 45-day editing window, it becomes read-only. Contact us to discuss any further changes.

How do I request a refund?

Contact us through the official contact details and include your order or payment information. We’ll review your request and reply with the next steps.

Can you build something fully custom?

Yes. The fifth step is optional: contact us with your idea and requirements, and we’ll discuss a custom website tailored to your needs.

Need help before you begin? Read how the process works, and confirm the scope, total cost, and refund terms before you pay.

03 / Our goal

Beautiful websites should be within reach.

“Elegant by design, inexpensive as choice.”

Our goal is simple. To make beautiful, practical websites more cost-efficient and accessible to individuals, creators, and small businesses. A good idea shouldn’t need a huge budget just to have a home online.
